question: What should I practice, and can you recommend an instructional video?
player_text:
Practice a same-spot free-throw set, using your comfortable arm extension as a checkpoint—not something to force. Keep the rest of your shot as usual.

After each shot, notice your finish and whether the ball reaches the basket. You’re looking for a comfortable finish and a clearer picture of your distance, not trying to fix your knee bend.

Form Shooting-2 Hands · Jr. NBA
https://jr.nba.com/video/form-shooting-2-hands/

Watch how the guide hand supports the ball and how the legs and shooting arm extend through the finish.

Watch how the shooting arm extends through the finish. Use it as a visual reference for your next set, without forcing your arm into a position.

Take a short set from one spot and think only about the finish. Review early follow-through across the next clips and log makes separately.
